Committee: Transportation and Energy
Sponsor: Roberts
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/10/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 58 as introduced creates the Underground Damage Prevention Fund within the State Treasury and provides that any receipts that were intended to be paid into the Fund prior to the effective date of this bill shall be deposited into the Fund. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Gerald H. Allen, Chair Person
Transportation and Energy

Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure

Date: 02/26/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 58 as passed the Senate statutorily creates the Underground Damage Prevention Fund within the State Treasury and provides that any receipts that were intended to be paid into the Fund prior to the effective date of this bill shall be deposited into the Fund. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Lynn Greer, Chair
Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure
